scope: Day 1 Prompt 5 final release review; planning preview only
head: 361b071b8c9dee47d73b666b3ac0e7ad116651a6
head_scope: Review of this HEAD plus the four uncommitted documentation/evidence changes listed below.

p2.finding: CPU phi-4-mini latency remains near the 28-second budget and live reliability is WEAK.
p2.disposition: DEFERRED; safe failures verified; no prompt, token, timeout or provider changes.

p2.finding: Intent alignment has only been evaluated for the small fixed supported study; general intent fidelity is not comprehensively evaluated.
p2.disposition: DEFERRED beyond Day 1; deterministic validation proves contract compliance only.

architecture: Intent -> vendor-neutral ModelProvider -> untrusted raw text -> strict parser -> JSON Schema -> deterministic semantics -> PlanValidated or PlanRejected

active_clarifications: Current final-review status and evidence link.
Explicit planning-only synthetic context, WEAK live reliability and production NOT VERIFIED.
Both historical five-attempt browser cohorts and diagnostic request are counted.

mock_live_separation.production_composition: main.py always composes LocalOpenAIProvider; no test flag, mock/debug route or success fallback.
mock_live_separation.deterministic_and_package_lanes: Controlled providers/transports are explicitly test evidence.
mock_live_separation.live_smoke: Actual browser -> actual product process -> real LocalOpenAIProvider -> existing CPU phi-4-mini; no interception or provider substitution.

deterministic_tests.test_integrity_review: Parser/schema/semantic negatives, downgrade/tool/target rejection, sanitized provider/HTTP failures, injection, 20-request isolation, safe rendering and stale result clearing exercise behavior. No material suite weakness requiring a Day 1 patch.

package_reproducibility.workflow: uv build; reinstall fresh wheel into the retained Prompt 4 environment; run tests/package_check.py outside repository with PYTHONPATH unset.

live_smoke.intent: Plan to read the service-demo record.

request.text: Plan to read the service-demo record.

live_smoke.cleanup_method: Owned fixture process terminated and waited after healthy GET; Windows termination exit code 1.
live_smoke.reliability_reclassification: NONE; one smoke is not another reliability study

1.evidence: Strict Intent schema forbids extra fields; Settings owns loopback endpoint. tests/test_plans_api.py and tests/test_configuration.py

2.invariant: Model cannot choose an untrusted tool
2.evidence: Canonical per-tool schema and independent trusted catalog resolution. tests/test_plan_validation.py

3.evidence: Exact aggregate trusted risk match, including injected maintenance downgrade. tests/test_hardening.py

4.evidence: Trusted service-demo allowlist, per-step target equality and synthetic revision checks. tests/test_plan_validation.py

5.invariant: Invalid model output never becomes trusted Plan
5.evidence: Strict parser, schema and semantics precede immutable Plan construction. tests/test_plan_validation.py and tests/test_plans_api.py

6.invariant: Rejected request never exposes successful Plan
6.evidence: plan:null in API; old fields cleared in browser; final live timeout shows no Plan. tests/browser/test_frontend.py and test_browser_e2e.py

7.invariant: No automatic retry or repair hides failures
7.evidence: One core/provider call, retries=0, no redirect or repair; final smoke has one POST. tests/test_model_provider.py and tests/test_hardening.py

8.evidence: Trusted catalog contains descriptions/schemas, no execution callables; production composition only generates and validates text.

9.invariant: Browser never renders raw model HTML
9.evidence: Plan text uses textContent; fixed errors only, with literal HTML-value browser coverage. tests/browser/test_frontend.py

10.evidence: Settings rejects non-loopback bind/model addresses; proxies and redirects disabled; live smoke uses 127.0.0.1. tests/test_configuration.py and tests/test_hardening.py

repository_hygiene.ignored_runtime_artifacts: Existing environments/caches/dist plus bounded review logs/evidence; not staged or tracked. Single-use browser probe removed.
repository_hygiene.retained_package_environment: Pre-existing Prompt 4 environment outside repository, reused as authorized; no new environment created.

known_limitations: Local CPU phi-4-mini latency is close to timeout; LIVE_RELIABILITY=WEAK.
Only synthetic service-demo context with revision 1 is supported; no live resource facts.
Planning preview only; no tool execution, approval workflow, persistence or MCP.
Authentication/RBAC, cloud providers, sandbox, orchestration and production exposure remain deferred.
Production reliability is NOT VERIFIED; general intent alignment is not comprehensively evaluated.
decision_basis: No unresolved P0/P1; full deterministic/browser/package gates pass; all ten invariants pass; the only live smoke timed out safely with the app healthy. Known limitations remain explicit.
